# browser_wasi_shim (vendored)

`@bjorn3/browser_wasi_shim` 0.4.2, the published `dist/` build, unmodified.
A synchronous WASI preview 1 implementation with an in-memory filesystem; the
in-browser REPL (`site/repl/`) runs `rustc.wasm` and `wild.wasm` on it inside a
Web Worker.

- Source: https://github.com/bjorn3/browser_wasi_shim
- Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-MIT`, `LICENSE-APACHE` here)

To update, replace the `.js` files with a newer release's `dist/` and bump the
version above.
